# Qt license texts

PCX Level Tool 0.1.x binary packages dynamically link Qt 6.8.3. The unmodified
license texts in `LICENSES` were copied from the official Qt Base `v6.8.3` tag:

- Repository: <https://github.com/qt/qtbase/tree/v6.8.3/LICENSES>
- Commit: `c07c2d5a527a644d36e7853d55132ae38921682f`

Qt and its bundled third-party components retain their respective copyrights
and license terms. These files are not covered by the PCX Level Tool MIT
License. Qt SVG 6.8.3 uses the applicable same-named texts from this set.

See the repository root `QT-LGPL-NOTICE.md` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for
the runtime-linking and corresponding-source information.
